<mxCell id="flow-header" value="<b>ShopCore — Transactional Checkout &amp; Inventory Locking Flow</b><br>End-to-End Sequence • Zero-Trust Price Recomputation • Pessimistic Inventory Lock • UPI UTR Reconciliation" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F172A;fontColor=#FFFFFF;align=left;spacingLeft=20;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="30" width="1060" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="step1" value="<b>1. Submit Cart &amp; Key</b><br>Client sends cart/express + Idempotency-Key + UTR &amp; receipt" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="125" width="230" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step2" value="<b>2. Auth &amp; Rate Limit</b><br>Verify session cookie, check rate limit" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="315" y="125" width="230" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step3" value="<b>3. Price Recomputation</b><br>Recalculate all totals in integer paise from DB" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="590" y="125" width="230" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step4" value="<b>4. Idempotency Lock</b><br>SHA-256 hash key, return cached or acquire lock" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFBEB;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="865" y="125" width="235" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step5" value="<b>5. Atomic Stock Lock</b><br>UPDATE product SET stock = stock - q WHERE stock &gt;= q" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="865" y="285" width="235" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step6" value="<b>6. UTR Format Check</b><br>Validate 12-digit NPCI RRN format &amp; anti-fraud patterns" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF1F2;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="590" y="285" width="230" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step7" value="<b>7. Claim UTR Anti-Replay</b><br>INSERT INTO utr_submissions (utrNormalized UNIQUE)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EEF2FF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontColor=#1E1B4B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="315" y="285" width="230" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step8" value="<b>8. Create Pending Order</b><br>Status PENDING_PAYMENT_REVIEW, commit DB transaction" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="285" width="230" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step9" value="<b>9. Customer Receipt UI</b><br>Returns 200 OK + orderNumber &amp; masked UTR" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF1F2;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="455" width="310" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step10" value="<b>10. Admin Statement Audit</b><br>Compares UTR &amp; amount against incoming bank credit" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFBEB;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="415" y="455" width="310" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step11" value="<b>11. Payment Verification Commit</b><br>Status -&gt; CONFIRMED, credits loyalty points, fulfills" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="455" width="310" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

g.text: ShopCore — Transactional Checkout & Inventory Locking Flow
End-to-End Sequence • Zero-Trust Price Recomputation • Pessimistic Inventory Lock • UPI UTR Reconciliation
• If duplicate key: return cached order
• UPDATE product SET stock = stock - q
• Admin reviews order in Back-Office Console
• Compares UTR & amount with bank statement credit
• Credits earned loyalty points to customer account
CRITICAL FAILURE MODES & DISTRIBUTED RECOVERY STRATEGIES
• Two users attempt to buy last item simultaneously.
• SQL WHERE stock >= qty evaluates atomically.
• User triggers Buy-Now but abandons checkout.
• Subsequent place-order rejects expired express row.
• Regular user cart remains completely untouched.
• Attacker or buggy client submits an already-used UTR.
• UNIQUE constraint on UtrSubmission trips P2002.
• Transaction aborts: zero stock deducted, no order.
• Rejection logged with IP & user agent forensics.
